review_comments_data.body: Hello @lebaphi - I'm pretty sure we can just delete/deprecate this component, and any custom children it has. The data model doesn't work for it, but it has been superceded by `coa-status-board-2`.  Deleting it will prevent us wasting time in having to fix/maintain compiler issues.

The test results here have been changed. But, are you confident the new test results are correct?  If you're not sure - then please create a `/TODO: check test results` - so we know the logic is still valid.

If you switch to `ParticipantCollab` instead of `CoreParticipant` then the below logic can still be done using the `viewUnreleasedVersions` property.  Aah, the `_channel` parameter won't be `ChannelData`, it will be `ChannelCollab`.  That will make the types easier.
This should be `ParticipantCollab`. The `if` structure should create the correct channel type - which in turn will create the correct participant type (well, I think it will).
I think the _correct_ route is for us to deprecate `ChannelData` - that will prevent us having to maintain it in this way.

Hmm, I don't like this class. I _think_ it should have a child member that stores an object of `ChannelTypes`.  Then we will still have access to the channel description (including participants), and collab-options if it's a `ChannelCollab`.

review_comments_data.body: Yes, I see this change.  But, our _model_ is that the Game Designer selects a permission, and the role has all permission levels up to that one.

Soon, this will get tidier, as we introduce "Add > Chat Channel" to the admin page, which will create an instance of `ChannelChat`.  A custom editor page will look like `Channel-Custom`, but it won't have the templates drop-down.

Have covered the above in https://github.com/serge-web/serge/issues/1295
